_comment: Issue #209 (journal internal tabs): THE canonical for the three-tab switcher. Loads journal_history_start (the same fixture journal_history pins -- the_errand complete, a bounty + delivery accepted, mage held@1) via title Continue, opens the journal, and proves: (1) every open lands on the Quests tab (active_tab:'quests' in the ui_journal_shown payload); (2) a TAP on each tab label (the new click_journal_tab driver action, mirroring click_credits_link/click_playtest_page) flips active_tab and re-emits ui_journal_shown with the FULL section payload intact (skill_count/skill_groups are present on EVERY tab's emit -- the plan's tab-independent-payload contract, which is why the ~20 payload-only journal canonicals survive the split untouched); (3) keyboard move_right/move_left switch tabs with wrap, parity with the taps. Body-text-per-tab is a windowed read (deferred to the controller with the real asset overlay); active_tab + the always-full payload are the headless-assertable proof. Canonical seed: 9 (fixture rng_state governs; held for convention).

steps._comment: Open -> lands on the Quests tab. The full section payload rides this event exactly as journal_history pins it (Postings/Completed/Skills all present regardless of the visible tab).
steps.name: journal

steps._comment: TAP the Skills tab label -> active_tab flips to 'skills'; the skill-section fields (skill_count 4, Innate/Mage groups) are STILL in the payload, proving the emit is the same full payload with only active_tab changed.
TAP the History tab label -> active_tab 'history'; payload still full (postings + skills fields unchanged).
== KEYBOARD PARITY == move_right cycles Quests->Skills->History->Quests (wrap); the emits mirror the taps above.
steps.name: move_right
